title: Historical Incident: Pump P-104 Drive-End Bearing Inner-Race Spalling and Overheating
reported_symptoms: High vibration alert on drive-end bearing (overall RMS reached 5.8 mm/s)
High-pitched metallic clicking and grinding noise
root_cause_diagnosis: Fatigue spalling on the inner ring raceway of the DE bearing (SKF 6205-2Z/C3) caused by prolonged operation with degraded grease and particulate contamination.
corrective_actions_taken: LOTO initiated per SOP-042 at MCC-02 cubicle 4B.
Pump decoupled and bearing housing disassembled.
Inspection confirmed severe micro-spalling and metal transfer along the inner raceway.
Replaced DE bearing with new SKF 6205-2Z/C3 using induction heater at 110°C per SOP-088.
Repacked with Mobil Polyrex EM synthetic grease.
Realigned pump-to-motor coupling to 0.03 mm offset using laser alignment.
Post-repair vibration dropped to 1.1 mm/s RMS (Zone A Good).
lessons_learned: Lubrication interval should not exceed 2,500 running hours. Ultrasonic acoustic monitoring should be scheduled bi-weekly.
